dateFeature.scope: Fresh matched production single-date fixture only; no inherited outcome or route claim

constructionFeature.scope: Unpromoted candidates; deterministic source-backed no-change dispositions do not require timing campaigns
constructionFeature.status: provisional until explicitly adopted by a named family before its runtime edits

decision: Within-mode matched medians and upper paired bootstrap uncertainty bounds must satisfy applicable practical limits. A primary median failure requires a changed candidate and complete new campaign; never selectively replace cells or relax budgets. Uncertainty crossing a limit leaves promotion unqualified pending a predeclared complete confirmation. Correctness/accessibility/ownership failures cannot be traded for savings. Cold policies missing latency bounds remain diagnostic. No microbenchmark establishes real-route benefit.

contextual-editor-toolbar.precedence: The separately frozen editor protocol controls all toolbar cells, latency and retention limits.
